name: scripted_subagent_delegation
description: Deterministic: parent delegates a calculation to a subagent, whose internal steps must NOT surface on parent-level metrics. Runs in CI; guards the recorder-scoping fix.
input: Delegate to a subagent this self-contained task: 'compute 347 * 29 and report the number.' Then tell me the number it returned.

arguments.task: Use the calculator tool to compute 347 * 29 and report the number.
